The Science
What is Exilis Elite?

Exilis Elite is an FDA-approved non-invasive body contouring and skin tightening device that combines monopolar radiofrequency (RF) energy and ultrasound technology. It's the only device that uses both simultaneously â delivering controlled heat to deep tissue layers while keeping the surface cool and comfortable.

Often described as 'as good as a facelift' in the beauty world, Exilis Elite transfers heat onto the deeper layers of the skin to shrink fat cells, stimulate collagen remodeling, and tighten loose skin â all in a quick lunchtime session with zero downtime.

Available exclusively at ISAAC Luxe, Exilis Elite treats everything from stubborn love handles and bingo wings to sagging jowls and neck skin. The advanced cooling system ensures complete comfort throughout, while delivering permanent fat cell destruction and long-lasting skin tightening results.

Dual Energy Science
How Does It Work?

Radiofrequency Energy

Monopolar RF energy (3.4MHz, up to 120W) penetrates deep into subdermal tissue, heating fat cells to cause permanent apoptosis (cell death). Simultaneously, it triggers collagen fiber contraction for an immediate tightening effect.

Ultrasound + Cooling

Ultrasound waves enhance fat lipolysis deep within tissue while the patented layered cooling system protects the skin surface. A built-in thermometer prevents overheating â ensuring safety and comfort throughout.

The Exilis Elite Process
1

Consultation & Assessment

Our dermatologist evaluates your body contouring goals, skin laxity, and target areas to create a personalized treatment plan.

2

Applicator Placement

The handpiece glides over the target area, delivering controlled RF and ultrasound energy. You feel a pleasant warming sensation throughout.

3

Deep Tissue Heating

RF energy heats fat cells to destroy them permanently while stimulating collagen production. Ultrasound enhances fat breakdown deep within tissue.

4

Resume Your Day

Zero downtime â resume activities immediately. Mild warmth for 1â2 hours. Drink plenty of water to flush eliminated fat cells. Results develop over 2â3 months.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is Exilis Elite painful?

Not at all. The treatment feels like a warm massage thanks to the built-in cooling system. Most clients find it very comfortable and relaxing. No anesthesia is needed.

When will I see results?

Many clients notice skin tightening from the first session. Visible fat reduction appears by session 3â4. Optimal results develop over 12â14 weeks as collagen remodels and fat cells are eliminated.

Are the results permanent?

Yes â fat cells destroyed by Exilis Elite are permanently eliminated. Results are long-lasting provided you maintain a healthy lifestyle. Skin tightening effects can be maintained with occasional sessions.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Absolutely! Exilis Elite pairs excellently with CoolSculpting, Emsculpt NEO, lymphatic drainage, and HydraFacial. Our experts can design a comprehensive body contouring plan for you.

How many sessions do I need?

The standard protocol is 4â6 sessions spaced 1â2 weeks apart. Some areas may require fewer sessions. Your dermatologist will customize the plan based on your goals.

Is there any downtime?

Absolutely none. It's truly a lunchtime treatment â walk in, 30 minutes of comfortable warming, walk out and continue your day. No redness, no bruising, no restrictions.
